high.title: Full Stack Engineer
high.description:
About Enterprise Bot
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world’s #1 AI-driven automation software provider within the next five years.
We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting-edge Conversational AI technology.
Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.
We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.
Your first months at Enterprise Bot
We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer with 2–4 years of experience who enjoys working across both frontend and backend and wants to build products at the intersection of software engineering and AI.
You’ll work on our AI-powered products and platforms, building everything from interactive user interfaces and dashboards to APIs, backend services, integrations, and AI-powered workflows.
This isn't a role where you'll just pick up tickets and write code.
We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of a feature end-to-end — understand the requirement, design the solution, build it, test it, and get it into production.
What You'll Do
Full Stack Development

- 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications across the frontend and backend.
- 
Build responsive, intuitive, and high-performance user interfaces using React and TypeScript.
- 
Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Node.js.
- 
Work across the complete product lifecycle — from technical design to development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
- 
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third-party services.
- 
Build reusable components and maintain clean, scalable code.


Backend & APIs

- 
Design and develop secure and reusable RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.
- 
Build backend services using Node.js, Express.js, Koa, or similar frameworks.
- 
Design efficient database schemas and optimise queries.
- 
Work with MongoDB and SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- 
Implement authentication and authorisation using technologies such as JWT and OAuth.
- 
Build integrations with internal and external systems.
- 
Troubleshoot production issues and improve system performance and reliability.


Frontend

- 
Build modern web interfaces using React and TypeScript.
- 
Translate product and UI designs into high-quality, production-ready interfaces.
- 
Create reusable UI components and contribute to frontend architecture.
- 
Ensure applications are responsive, accessible, and performant.
- 
Work closely with Product and Design teams to turn ideas into intuitive user experiences.


AI & Agentic Systems
You’ll be working in an AI-first engineering environment.

- 
Integrate LLM APIs and AI capabilities into production applications.
- 
Work with AI-powered workflows and intelligent automation.
- 
Build or integrate agent-based systems and tool orchestration.
- 
Work with AI APIs, inference workflows, prompt orchestration, and model integrations.
- 
Explore new approaches to building AI-powered product experiences.
- 
Stay curious about emerging AI technologies and developer tools.


You don't need to be an AI/ML researcher. We’re looking for strong software engineers who are excited about learning and building with AI.
Quality, Performance & Reliability

- 
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
- 
Write unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Mocha, or Chai.
- 
Debug issues across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
- 
Identify performance bottlenecks and improve application scalability.
- 
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
- 
Document technical solutions, APIs, and architecture where required.


Collaboration

- 
Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, AI Engineers, QA, DevOps, and other developers.
- 
Participate in technical discussions and architecture decisions.
- 
Break down product requirements into practical technical solutions.
- 
Take ownership of features and deliver them from concept → production.
- 
Contribute to a collaborative and fast-moving engineering culture.


What we are looking for

- 
2–4 years of professional experience in full-stack software development.
- 
Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript.
- 
Strong backend development experience with Node.js.
- 
Good hands-on experience with React and modern frontend development.
- 
Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL APIs.
- 
Strong understanding of MongoDB and experience with at least one SQL database such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- 
Good understanding of asynchronous programming, promises, async/await, and event-driven architecture.
- 
Experience with authentication and authorisation mechanisms such as JWT and OAuth.
- 
Good understanding of software development best practices, testing, debugging, and version control.
- 
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
- 
Ability to troubleshoot production issues and work independently.
- 
Good understanding of responsive web development.
- 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
- 
Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional team.


Good to Have

- 
Experience with AI/LLM integrations.
- 
Experience working with AI agents or agentic workflows.
- 
Experience with real-time systems or event-driven architectures.
- 
Exposure to voice technologies, streaming, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech.
- 
Experience with Redis or other caching technologies.
- 
Experience with microservices architecture.
- 
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- 
Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- 
Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
- 
Experience working in a SaaS or B2B product company.
- 
Exposure to AI coding assistants and AI-powered development workflows.


What We Value
At Enterprise Bot, we value ownership over titles.
We're looking for someone who:

- 
Doesn't wait for instructions for every step.
- 
Can take a problem and figure out how to solve it.
- 
Is comfortable working in a fast-changing startup environment.
- 
Cares about the quality of what they build.
- 
Is curious about AI and new technologies.
- 
Enjoys learning and experimenting.
- 
Can balance speed with good engineering practices.
- 
Is comfortable working across different parts of the technology stack.


Benefits

- 
Build products at the forefront of GenAI and Conversational AI.
- 
Work on real-world AI products used by international enterprises.
- 
Get exposure to LLMs, AI agents, automation, voice, and real-time systems.
- 
Work with a global engineering and product team.
- 
High ownership and the opportunity to make a visible impact.
- 
Flat hierarchy and an open, collaborative culture.
- 
Opportunity to learn and work with rapidly evolving AI technologies.
- 
Competitive compensation and strong opportunities for growth.


Join our team
If you're excited about building full-stack products and want to work where software engineering meets AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Location: Lisboa, Noida, Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Katowice, Lodz

Posting Start Date: 11/12/26

At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.

AI & Automation Solutions Developer

Location: Portugal / Poland / Costa Rica

Reports to: Product Owner / Chief Architect

Role Overview

We are looking for a motivated Solutions Developer to join our Product team responsible for developing, enhancing, and supporting cloud-based Contact Center and AI solutions built on Amazon Connect and AWS.

This role is ideal for an early-career engineer who enjoys problem-solving, software development, cloud technologies, and Artificial Intelligence. You will work alongside senior engineers, solution architects, and product owners to deliver innovative customer-facing capabilities including AI Agents, conversational AI, automation, voice translation, analytics, and core system integrations.

The Role Is Approximately



- 70% Solution Development, Testing & Implementation 
- 15% Operational Support 
- 10% Solution Design & Technical Learning 
- 5% Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration 

Key Responsibilities

Solution Development



- Develop, test, implement and support solutions built on AWS and other Cloud technologies. 
- Build integrations between contact center platforms, AI services, ITSM tools, and enterprise applications. 
- Assist in the delivery of AI-powered capabilities including AI Agents, Agent Assist, RAG solutions, translation services and workflow automation. 
- Troubleshoot defects and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. 
- Follow engineering standards, coding best practices, and security guidelines. 

AI & Innovation



- Support the development and testing of Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions. 
- Assist with prompt engineering, knowledge bases, AI orchestration, and conversational AI use cases. 
- Contribute to experimentation, prototyping, and evaluation of new AI capabilities. 

Testing & Support



- Create and execute unit, integration, and end-to-end tests. 
- Support deployment, release, and operational activities. 
- Assist in diagnosing and resolving production issues. 
- Contribute to technical documentation and support materials. 

Collaboration & Learning



- Work closely with Product Owners, Architects, Developers, BAU specialists and Service desk operational teams. 
- Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and demonstrations. 
- Continuously develop technical expertise in AWS, AI technologies, and software engineering practices. 

Qualification, Skills & Experience

Experience, academic exposure, or strong interest in the following:



- AI & LLM Technologies: Generative AI, AI Agents, OpenAI APIs, Amazon Bedrock, Prompt Engineering. 
- Software Development: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Node.js, REST APIs, JSON, API integrations. 
- Frontend Development: React, Redux Toolkit (RTK), TypeScript, Micro-frontends, Accessibility (A11y). 
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Amazon Connect, Lambda, S3, Redshift, CloudFormation, CDK), Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code. 
- Professional Skills: Problem solving, technical troubleshooting and debugging skills, stakeholder engagement, technical communication, Agile delivery, teamwork, and continuous learning. 
- Certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AI Practitioner or Developer – Associate or Solutions Architect – Associate; Agile Fundamentals. 

Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through



- Delivery of assigned stories and tasks within agreed sprint timelines. 
- Quality and reliability of developed solutions. 
- Contribution to successful product and project outcomes. 
- Reduction in defects and rework. 
- Growth in technical capability and AWS expertise. 
- Positive feedback from stakeholders and team members. 

Relocation Supported: No

Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

Qualcomm's CAD Infrastructure team develops and operates mission-critical engineering platforms used by thousands of engineers across CPU, DSP, AI, SoC, Physical Design, Verification, and Software organizations. We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and scale modern web applications, automation platforms, data services, and AI-enabled solutions that improve engineering productivity across the company.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys working across the full technology stack—from intuitive front-end user experiences to highly scalable backend services, cloud-native infrastructure, data platforms, and AI-driven workflows.

You will collaborate closely with engineering teams, technical program managers, DevOps engineers, and infrastructure architects to deliver tools that are used daily by Qualcomm's engineering community.

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

medium.title: Staff IT Software Engineer
medium.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

As a Staff Full Stack Engineer, you will be a technical leader and a key driver behind our product’s architecture, user experience, and intelligent capabilities.

This role demands a unique combination of enterprise-grade backend stability, modern frontend design, and the ability to

integrate cutting-edge AI technologies natively built on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

You will partner closely with Product, UX Design, Architecture, and Data Science teams to translate high-level business goals into robust full-stack applications. You will be instrumental in building autonomous AI agentic solutions that proactively plan and execute multi-step tasks,

leveraging our enterprise AI platforms to deliver low-latency, scalable, and ethical implementations. While you will remain deeply hands-on, your success will also be measured by your ability to elevate the engineers around you, champion design standards, and turn complex

AI paradigms into seamless user experiences.



- Design, build, and scale highly available, secure backend microservices alongside modern, performance-optimized, and responsive frontends.
- Design, orchestrate, and deploy production-ready agentic workflows that leverage LLM
- reasoning, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for independent decision-making and complex task execution.
- Develop core full-stack components that interface with Generative AI model deployment and real-time inference systems. Optimize large-scale AI interactions for performance, low latency, and high throughput.
- Establish long-term architectural patterns and tooling choices for our Java, Next.js, and Google Cloud ecosystem, preferably GCP Vertex AI or equivalent.
- Champion design standards, rigorous type safety, automated testing, and comprehensive monitoring across decoupled repositories, UI components, and AI inference pipelines.
- Ensure all full-stack applications and integrated AI systems comply with enterprise security policies, data privacy standards, and responsible AI principles.
- Lead deep technical design reviews, perform high-impact code reviews, mentor engineers, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning.

Qualifications



- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of operating at a Staff, or Tech Lead level.
- 2+ years of hands-on experience designing, fine-tuning, and building autonomous AIagentic solutions, LLM architectures, and RAG pipelines in a production setting.
- Expert-level experience with Java and Spring Boot (or equivalent enterprise frameworks like Go or advanced Node.js) building resilient distributed systems and secure RESTful APIs. Experience with SQL (MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) schema design and performance tuning.
- Deep experience building complex, production-grade web applications using React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js. Strong understanding of SSR (Server-Side Rendering).
- State management, and building intuitive, responsive interfaces for data-dense AI workflows.
- Strong experience designing and deploying distributed systems on Google Cloud Platform, specifically using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) or Cloud Run, alongside modern CI/CD tools (Harness, Jenkins).
- A strong focus on the end-user. You understand how to handle the unique UI/UX challenges of Generative AI, such as streaming model responses, conversational state management, and elegant fallback UI states.
- Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical, cloud, and AI concepts to both deeply technical engineers and non-technical business stakeholders.

Preferred / Bonus Points



- Proficiency in Python for backend development, quick AI prototyping, and data
- processing.
- Experience with open-source AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
- Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity principles for AI applications.

Our Commitment 

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

stretch.title: Senior Software Engineer (React + Node)
stretch.description:
About Tricog
Tricog is a healthcare technology, product-based company headquartered in Bangalore. We build predictive and virtual diagnostic solutions for cardiovascular diseases, enabling clinicians to make faster, more accurate decisions that save lives.
Our software directly supports clinical decision-making. As a result, we place a strong emphasis on correctness, reliability, security, and data privacy.


Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong frontend expertise who can independently design, build, and deliver high-quality features across the stack. You will play a key role in shaping implementation decisions, improving engineering standards, and mentoring junior engineers.
This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy owning problems end-to-end and working closely with product, clinical, and engineering stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities
● Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across frontend and backend systems
● Build scalable, maintainable frontend applications using React.js
● Design and implement robust backend services and APIs using Node.js
● Own feature delivery from requirements clarification to production release
● Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
● Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code
● Review code from peers and raise the overall quality bar
● Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, including root cause analysis
● Collaborate with product managers, designers, and clinicians to refine requirements
● Ensure adherence to security, privacy, and reliability best practices, especially for healthcare data
● Actively contribute to improving engineering processes, tooling, and standards
● Use modern developer tooling, including AI-assisted development tools, to improve productivity while maintaining high standards of code quality, reliability, and maintainability.


Required Skills & Experience
● 4–7 years of professional software engineering experience
● Strong proficiency in JavaScript and Typescript
● Strong proficiency in HTML/CSS
● Solid experience with
○ React.js and modern frontend patterns
○ Node.js and RESTful API design
● Experience working with databases
○ SQL (MySQL / PostgreSQL)
● Strong understanding of
○ Software design principles
○ Performance optimization
○ Error handling and observability
● Hands-on experience with
○ Unit and integration testing
○ Git-based workflows and code reviews
○ CI/CD pipelines
○ Any of the cloud platforms like AWS, GCP
● Ability to debug complex issues across the stack
● Clear communication and collaboration skills
● Demonstrates sound judgment in leveraging AI-assisted tools—knowing when to use them and when not to.


Nice-to-Have
● Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-native systems
● Exposure to healthcare, medical devices, or regulated domains
● Experience designing APIs or systems consumed at scale
● Prior mentoring experience


Why Join Tricog (Senior Level)
● Own meaningful features used in real clinical workflows
● Influence technical decisions and engineering practices
● Work on systems where correctness truly matters
● Grow toward Staff/Lead roles with increasing scope and impact
